title: Invasion landing: split default and planet effects
description: The landing tray splits the default landing over uninhabited planets and shows, per planet, what taking it does (exploration, legendary ability, attachments, Mecatol, contested or not). Synthetic fixtures, not captured engine states; before shots taken on the base commit with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and committed, after shots regenerated by the runner.

shots.heading: Three uninhabited planets, 6 infantry - desktop, before
shots.caption: Base commit (unified-latest-2026-10-08): single-target default, no effect lines.

shots.heading: Three uninhabited planets, 6 infantry - desktop, after
shots.caption: Before: all six infantry stacked on one planet. After: 2/2/2 with a split hint and per-planet counts, plus each planet's explore line.

notes.title: Policy.
notes.text: Uninhabited = no unit of another player on the planet and not already held by you. No targets: everything on the best (defended) planet as before. Targets only: one force each in value order, rest round-robin, mech on the best planet. Mixed: defended planet keeps at least half, the weakest units spread one each.
